nodes.description: AugustusStorage.tokenTransferProxy - external proxy contract used to pull tokens from msg.sender into the router
AugustusStorage.feeWallet - payable address receiving paraswap and positive-slippage shares
AugustusStorage.registeredPartners - mapping of partner address to FeeStructure used to compute partner share
AugustusStorage.WHITELISTED_ROLE - role hash checked before delegating to an adapter
FeeModel.partnerSharePercent - immutable percentage of the fee given to the partner
FeeModel.maxFeePercent - immutable cap applied to the caller-supplied feePercent
ProtectedMultiPath.protectedMultiSwap(Utils.SellData) payable - executes a multi-path swap, checks deadline, pulls funds, performs swap, takes fee and transfers remainder
ProtectedMultiPath.protectedMegaSwap(Utils.MegaSwapSellData) payable - executes a mega-path swap splitting fromAmount across several paths
ProtectedMultiPath.performSwap - loops over paths/adapters, verifies whitelist role and delegatecalls each adapter to swap tokens
ProtectedMultiPath.transferTokensFromProxy - applies optional permit and pulls the source tokens via tokenTransferProxy.transferFrom
ProtectedMultiPath.retrieveEth - forwards the whole contract ETH balance to msg.sender with a low-level call
FeeModel.takeFeeAndTransferTokens - computes fee/positive slippage and pushes tokens to partner, feeWallet and beneficiary
FeeModel._takeFee - computes fee, partnerShare and paraswapShare and transfers both shares
ProtectedMultiPath.initialize - always reverts, method not implemented
ProtectedMultiPath.getKey - pure function returning the router identifier hash
msg.sender - caller of the swap, default beneficiary, source of funds and recipient of leftover ETH
block.timestamp - compared against data.deadline inside both swap entrypoints
adapter.adapter.delegatecall(IAdapter.swap.selector, ...) - delegatecall into a whitelisted adapter, executes in router storage context
msg.sender.call{value: balance, gas: 10000}("") - low-level ETH transfer to the caller at the end of the swap
Utils.transferTokens - performs destination.call{value: amount, gas: 10000} or IERC20.safeTransfer when distributing funds
Utils.permit - arbitrary token.call(abi.encodePacked(IERC20Permit.permit.selector, permit)) with user-supplied payload
data (Utils.SellData) parameter of protectedMultiSwap, fully attacker controlled
fromToken - source token resolved from data.fromToken in protectedMultiSwap/protectedMegaSwap
beneficiary - data.beneficiary or msg.sender when zero, receives the swapped amount
receivedAmount - token balance of the router after the swap, used for slippage checks
toToken - destination token derived from the last path element
token parameter of transferTokensFromProxy
amount parameter of transferTokensFromProxy
permit bytes parameter of transferTokensFromProxy forwarded to Utils.permit
path (Utils.Path[]) parameter of performSwap
fromAmount parameter of performSwap
_fromToken - token of the current hop inside performSwap
fromAmountSlice - amount forwarded to the adapter, computed from adapter.percent
value - adapter.networkFee passed to the delegatecall
toToken parameter of takeFeeAndTransferTokens
receivedAmount parameter of takeFeeAndTransferTokens
beneficiary parameter of takeFeeAndTransferTokens
user-supplied feePercent parameter of takeFeeAndTransferTokens
fee - total fee computed in takeFeeAndTransferTokens/_takeFee
remainingAmount - amount left for the beneficiary after fees/positive slippage
partnerShare - share of the fee transferred to the partner
paraswapShare - share of the fee transferred to feeWallet

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the default beneficiary when data.beneficiary is address(0)
protectedMultiSwap compares data.deadline against block.timestamp, making execution timestamp dependent
protectedMultiSwap calls transferTokensFromProxy to pull the source tokens
protectedMultiSwap calls performSwap to execute the route
protectedMultiSwap calls takeFeeAndTransferTokens to distribute output
protectedMultiSwap calls retrieveEth at the end of the flow
protectedMegaSwap compares data.deadline against block.timestamp, making execution timestamp dependent
protectedMegaSwap calls transferTokensFromProxy to pull the source tokens
protectedMegaSwap calls performSwap once per mega path
protectedMegaSwap calls takeFeeAndTransferTokens to distribute output
protectedMegaSwap calls retrieveEth at the end of the flow
msg.sender is used as the default beneficiary in protectedMegaSwap
transferTokensFromProxy invokes tokenTransferProxy.transferFrom with the stored proxy address
msg.sender is passed as the 'from' address of tokenTransferProxy.transferFrom
transferTokensFromProxy forwards the user-supplied permit blob to Utils.permit which performs a raw call
performSwap delegatecalls an externally supplied adapter, giving it control in the router storage context
performSwap requires hasRole(WHITELISTED_ROLE, adapter.adapter) before delegating, gating the access
retrieveEth transfers the full ETH balance to msg.sender via a low-level call, enabling a callback into the router
msg.sender is the recipient of the ETH drained by retrieveEth
msg.sender controls the receiving address of the low-level ETH transfer in retrieveEth
takeFeeAndTransferTokens pushes fee shares and the remainder through Utils.transferTokens
feeWallet receives the positive slippage share when no partner fee applies
registeredPartners[partner] provides partnerShare, noPositiveSlippage and positiveSlippageToUser
maxFeePercent caps the caller supplied feePercent before fee computation
partnerSharePercent is used inside _takeFee to split the fee between partner and paraswap
takeFeeAndTransferTokens delegates the actual fee split to _takeFee
_takeFee transfers partnerShare and paraswapShare using Utils.transferTokens
msg.sender is emitted as initiator in the Swapped event of protectedMultiSwap
msg.sender is emitted as initiator in the Swapped event of protectedMegaSwap
the SellData parameter supplies deadline, tokens, path and feePercent used by protectedMultiSwap
fromToken is forwarded to transferTokensFromProxy
toToken is forwarded to takeFeeAndTransferTokens
beneficiary is forwarded to takeFeeAndTransferTokens
receivedAmount is forwarded to takeFeeAndTransferTokens
path array drives the loop and adapter selection in performSwap
fromAmount is the initial amount processed by performSwap
_fromToken determines the token balance and network fee handling inside performSwap
fromAmountSlice is the computed amount passed to the adapter delegatecall
networkFee value is forwarded to the adapter delegatecall
token parameter selects the asset pulled through the token transfer proxy
amount parameter is the quantity pulled from msg.sender
permit parameter is the attacker-supplied payload forwarded to Utils.permit
toToken parameter of takeFeeAndTransferTokens selects the distributed asset
receivedAmount parameter of takeFeeAndTransferTokens is the fee base
beneficiary parameter of takeFeeAndTransferTokens receives the remainder
feePercent parameter of takeFeeAndTransferTokens is user supplied and capped by maxFeePercent
computed fee reduces the amount eventually transferred via Utils.transferTokens
remainingAmount is the value transferred to the beneficiary through Utils.transferTokens
partnerShare is transferred to the partner by Utils.transferTokens
paraswapShare is transferred to feeWallet by Utils.transferTokens

normalization_plan.reason: SellData parameter is the sole input of protectedMultiSwap and carries deadline, path and feePercent
fromToken local is derived from the caller data inside protectedMultiSwap and pushed to the proxy
beneficiary local is the payout target consumed by takeFeeAndTransferTokens
receivedAmount local is the fee base consumed by takeFeeAndTransferTokens
toToken local is the distributed asset consumed by takeFeeAndTransferTokens
token parameter is only used by transferTokensFromProxy to select the pulled asset
amount parameter is only used by transferTokensFromProxy as the pulled quantity
permit parameter is only used by transferTokensFromProxy and forwarded to Utils.permit
path parameter drives the loop and adapter iteration of performSwap
fromAmount parameter is the initial amount handled by performSwap
_fromToken local only exists to select balances inside performSwap
fromAmountSlice local is computed and consumed inside performSwap
value local only carries the adapter network fee into the performSwap delegatecall
toToken parameter belongs entirely to takeFeeAndTransferTokens
receivedAmount parameter belongs entirely to takeFeeAndTransferTokens
beneficiary parameter belongs entirely to takeFeeAndTransferTokens
feePercent parameter belongs entirely to takeFeeAndTransferTokens
fee local directly determines the amounts moved by Utils.transferTokens
remainingAmount local directly determines the amount moved by Utils.transferTokens
partnerShare local directly determines the amount moved by Utils.transferTokens
paraswapShare local directly determines the amount moved by Utils.transferTokens
